## Why ATS Implementations Fail

An Applicant Tracking System should be the backbone of your recruiting operation. But 60% of implementations fail to deliver expected value. Here are the seven most common mistakes and how to avoid them.

### Mistake 1: Choosing Based on Features, Not Workflow

The problem : Selecting the ATS with the longest feature list instead of the one that matches how your team actually works.

The fix : Map your current hiring workflow. Identify bottlenecks. Choose the ATS that solves your top 3 workflow problems.

### Mistake 2: Insufficient Training

The problem : Rolling out the system with a single training session and expecting adoption.

The fix :

- Training plan for each user role (recruiter, hiring manager, coordinator)
- Hands-on workshops, not just demos
- Quick-reference guides for common tasks
- Designated power users in each department

### Mistake 3: Dirty Data Migration

The problem : Migrating garbage data from old systems into the new ATS.

The fix :

- Audit data before migration
- Clean duplicates and outdated records
- Define data standards going forward
- Archival policy for inactive candidates

### Mistake 4: No Integration Strategy

The problem : ATS operates as an island, disconnected from email, calendar, HRIS, and sourcing tools.

The fix :

- Map all integration requirements before selection
- Prioritize: calendar sync, email integration, and sourcing partner integration
- Test integrations during trial period

### Mistake 5: Over-Customization

The problem : Customizing every field, workflow, and template — creating a system too complex to maintain.

The fix : Start with default workflows. Customize only where your process genuinely differs from best practice. Review quarterly.

### Mistake 6: Ignoring the Candidate Experience

The problem : Optimizing for recruiter efficiency without considering how candidates interact with the system.

The fix :

- Test the candidate-facing experience (apply to your own jobs)
- Mobile optimization
- Minimal required fields
- Clear status communication

### Mistake 7: No Measurement Plan

The problem : No defined metrics to evaluate whether the ATS is delivering value.

The fix : Define success metrics before launch:

- Time-to-fill improvement
- Recruiter productivity (hires per recruiter)
- Application completion rate
- Data accuracy score
- User satisfaction (quarterly survey)

### ATS Selection Checklist

Before committing:

- ☐ Demo with real scenarios (not canned demos)
- ☐ Talk to 3+ references of similar size/industry
- ☐ Test candidate experience on mobile
- ☐ Confirm integration capabilities
- ☐ Understand pricing model (per user, per hire, flat)
- ☐ Review contract terms (especially exit clauses)

Your ATS works best when paired with quality inputs. Subscription sourcing delivers pre-scored candidates directly into your pipeline.
